ESSENCE: [0] Subtle-five tooled ten by touch. [1] Veiled-shown depends; ebb-flow conditions. [2] Longed union arose; else supreme. [3] Four bear inside triśaṅku-hung. [4] Three became emission, clear-created widely. [5] Mixed may-stir within, never without.

paragraphs.text: Take the subtle five and tool them into ten by touch. Then know the dependency: the veiled and the shown depend on each other, and ebb and flow set the conditions for everything.
Longed-for union arose — and anything else is just supreme. Four powers bear the inside, hung like Triśaṅku between knowing and inert. Three became emission, then created widely and clearly.
Last rule: self-powers mixed may stir — but only within, never without.
